warnings: Every footing is printed 'F<n>, C1' — footing mark + the column C1 standing on it (C1 = 0.20 x 0.20, 4-DB12 on S-06). C1 is recorded here once (6 points).

Spec conflict, not resolved by renaming: the plan marks only F1 and F2, but the only footing detail sheet in the set (S-05) details F3 and F4. The sheet numbering jumps S-03 -> S-05, and the downloaded set has no S-04 — the sheet that would detail F1/F2. Scaled on the plan (A-B = 3.50 as the ruler): F1 measures about 1.20 x 1.20 with 3 x 3 = 9 pile symbols, F2 about 1.65 x 1.20 with 4 x 3 = 12 pile symbols — the same sizes and pile layouts S-05 gives for F3 (1.20 x 1.20, 9 piles) and F4 (1.65 x 1.20, 12 piles). Marks are kept exactly as printed (F1/F2 here, F3/F4 on S-05); a spec join by element_id will find nothing for F1/F2, which is the honest state of this set. The geometric match is recorded in each note for a later reader, not used to invent a spec.
F2 is drawn with its long side (≈1.65) along x at A1, B1 and B2.
